43551-the-white-horses.creator: Unknown
43551-the-white-horses.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Up through the rich valley known now as Wensleydale, but in those days marked by the lustier name of Yoredale, news had crept that there was civil war in England, that sundry skirmishes had been fought already, and that His Majesty was needing all leal men to rally to his standard.

arxiv-2106-02109.title: Factorials and powers, a minimality result, revisited
arxiv-2106-02109.creator: David E. Radford
arxiv-2106-02109.description: Abstract Let a > 1 a>1 . Then a n < n ! a^{n}<n! for some positive integer n n . There are several numerical sequences associated with the study of the smallest such integer which are studied in [ 2 ] and [ 3 ] . Here we continue the examination of one of them.

arxiv-2205-02628.title: Is there a trade-off relation between efficiency and power in a collisional Penrose process in an extreme Reissner-Nordström spacetime?
arxiv-2205-02628.creator: Naoki Tsukamoto 1
arxiv-2205-02628.description: Abstract We investigate the power of a collisional Penrose process with an unbound energy extraction from an extreme Reissner-Nordström black hole. This process takes infinite time in a time coordinate at a constant radial coordinate outside of the black hole.

arxiv-2306-15860.title: Federated Deep Reinforcement Learning - based Bitrate Adaptation for Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP Thanks: Phuong L. Vo, Nghia T. Nguyen, Long Luu are with the International University, Vietnam National University, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam; Canh T. Dinh, Nguyen H. Tran are with the Universit
arxiv-2306-15860.creator: Phuong L. Vo, Nghia T. Nguyen, Long Luu
arxiv-2306-15860.description: Abstract In video streaming over HTTP, the bitrate adaptation selects the quality of video chunks depending on the current network condition. Some previous works have applied deep reinforcement learning (DRL) algorithms to determine the chunk’s bitrate from the observed states to maximize the quality-of-experience (QoE).

arxiv-2409-02437.title: Fuzzy Logic Control for Indoor Navigation of Mobile Robots
arxiv-2409-02437.creator: Akshay Kumar, Ashwin Sahasrabudhe, Sanjuksha Nirgude
arxiv-2409-02437.description: Abstract Autonomous mobile robots have many applications in indoor unstructured environment, wherein optimal movement of the robot is needed. The robot therefore needs to navigate in unknown and dynamic environments. This paper presents an implementation of fuzzy logic controller for navigation of mobile robot in an unknown dynamically cluttered environment.

arxiv-2410-14353.title: Assistive AI for augmenting human decision-making
arxiv-2410-14353.creator: Natabara Máté Gyöngyössy, Bernát Török, Csilla Farkas, Laura Lucaj, Attila Menyhárd, Krisztina Menyhárd-Balázs, András Simonyi, Patrick van der Smagt, Zsolt Ződi, András Lőrincz
arxiv-2410-14353.description: Abstract Regulatory frameworks for the use of AI are emerging. However, they trail behind the fast-evolving malicious AI technologies that can quickly cause lasting societal damage. In response, we introduce a pioneering Assistive AI framework designed to enhance human decision-making capabilities.

arxiv-2504-04750.title: Competing effect of disorder on phase separation in active systems: from facilitated to hindered growth and rough interfaces
arxiv-2504-04750.creator: Pratikshya Jena 1, Shambhavi Dikshit 2, Shradha Mishra 1
arxiv-2504-04750.description: Abstract We investigate the impact of random pinned disorder on a collection of self-propelled particles. To achieve this, we construct a continuum model by formulating the coupled hydrodynamic equations for slow variables: local density and momentum density of particles. The disorder in the system acts as pinning sites, effectively immobilizing the particles that come into contact with them.

arxiv-2505-13405.title: A Dataless Reinforcement Learning Approach to Rounding Hyperplane Optimization for Max-Cut
arxiv-2505-13405.creator: Gabriel Malikal, Ismail Alkhouri, Alvaro Velasquez, Adam M Alessio, Saiprasad Ravishankar
arxiv-2505-13405.description: Abstract The Maximum Cut (MaxCut) problem is NP-Complete, and obtaining its optimal solution is NP-hard in the worst case. As a result, heuristic-based algorithms are commonly used, though their design often requires significant domain expertise. More recently, learning-based methods trained on large (un)labeled datasets have been proposed; however, these approaches often struggle with generalizability and scalability.

arxiv-2512-16176.title: Unified dynamical system formulations for f ⁡ ( R , ϕ , X ) f(R,\phi,X) gravity with applications to nonminimal derivative coupling and R 2 R^{2} -Higgs inflation
arxiv-2512-16176.creator: Saikat Chakraborty, Sergio E. Jorás, Alberto Saa
arxiv-2512-16176.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saikat Chakraborty, Sergio E. Jorás, Alberto Saa. Two different dynamical system formulations are presented for the generic f ⁡ ( R , ϕ , X ) f(R,\phi,X) family of gravity theories. As illustrative examples, the first and the second formulation is applied to study the phase space of a toy model of the Non-Minimal Derivative Coupling (NMDC) without a potential, and the mixed R 2 R^{2} -Higgs inflation model, respectively.

arxiv-2602-19436.title: Improving calibration accuracy with torque coupled gravity field calibrator for sub-Hz gravitational wave observation in CHRONOS
arxiv-2602-19436.creator: Yuki Inoue, Daiki Tanabe, Vivek Kumar
arxiv-2602-19436.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Yuki Inoue, Daiki Tanabe, Vivek Kumar. A fundamental challenge in low-frequency gravitational-wave detectors is the limited signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of calibration lines, particularly in torsion-bar systems where the response is governed by rotational dynamics. In this work, we resolve this issue by optimizing the geometrical configuration of a torque-coupled gravity field calibrator (GCal), achieving an improvement in calibration-line SNR by more than an order of magnitude compared to conventional layouts.

britannica-1911-montalembert-marc-rene-m.title: Montalembert, Marc René, Marquis de (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-montalembert-marc-rene-m.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-montalembert-marc-rene-m.description: Article 'Montalembert, Marc René, Marquis de' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 18), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. French military engineer and writer, was born at Angoulême on the 16th of July 1714, and entered the French Army in 1732. He fought in the War of the Polish Succession on the Rhine (1733–34), and in the War of the Austrian Succession made the campaigns of 1742 in Bohemia and Italy.

pmc-10481521.title: Fucose as a nutrient ligand for Dikarya and a building block of early diverging lineages
pmc-10481521.creator: Małgorzata Orłowska, Drishtee Barua, Sebastian Piłsyk, Anna Muszewska
pmc-10481521.description: Fucose is a deoxyhexose sugar present and studied in mammals. The process of fucosylation has been the primary focus in studies relating to fucose in animals due to the presence of fucose in Lewis antigens. Very few studies have reported its presence in Fungi, mostly in Mucoromycotina.

Among the AT‐E cohort, 51.9% received platelet aggregation inhibitors, 36.

pmc-11591892.title: Hippocampal Leptin Resistance and Cognitive Decline: Mechanisms, Therapeutic Strategies and Clinical Implications
pmc-11591892.creator: Ismael Valladolid-Acebes, Christa Buechler
pmc-11591892.description: Background: Leptin, an adipokine essential for regulating energy balance, exerts important effects on brain function, notably within the hippocampus, a region integral to learning and memory. Leptin resistance, characterized by diminished responsiveness to elevated leptin levels, disrupts hippocampal function and exacerbates both obesity and cognitive impairments.

pmc-11689658.title: A novel approach for efficient co-expression of two foreign genes based on the reverse genetic system of Newcastle disease virus
pmc-11689658.creator: Ting Lan, Qilong Liu, Jinying Ge, Yong Wang
pmc-11689658.description: Newcastle disease virus (NDV) is an ideal model for exploring the mechanisms of the virus; it is also an optimal vector for developing vector vaccines and for cancer therapy. A reverse genetic system of NDV Mukteswar strain controlled by eukaryotic cellular RNA polymerase II promoter was established by reverse genetics technology.

pmc-12515983.title: Longitudinal trajectories of major depressive disorder provide further clinical perspectives for precision psychiatry
pmc-12515983.creator: Murat İlhan Atagün
pmc-12515983.description: Major depressive disorder (MDD) is a common and debilitating disorder. MDD was considered to be a relatively benign disorder compared to other major psychiatric disorders. However, longitudinal research revealed heterogeneous and frequently chronic course. Episodic or chronic progress reframes MDD as a disorder with a variable and enduring course.

pmc-12616972.title: T-cell receptor therapy in ovarian cancer: concepts and challenges
pmc-12616972.creator: Xiaohan Wang, Zhuoyao Li, Mengwen Zhang, Yunhe Yu, Weihua Tong
pmc-12616972.description: With high rates of occurrence, recurrence, and mortality, ovarian cancer(OC) is among the most prevalent malignant neoplasms of the female reproductive system, which frequently result in a poor prognosis. The limited efficacy of early diagnosis and screening measures results in 75% of patients being diagnosed at an advanced stage.

pmc-12654167.title: Two Novel Microbacterium Species Isolated from Citrullus colocynthis L. (Cucurbitaceae), a Medicinal Plant from Arid Environments
pmc-12654167.creator: Khadija Ait Si Mhand, Salma Mouhib, Nabil Radouane, Khaoula Errafii, Issam Meftah Kadmiri, Derly Madeleiny Andrade-Molina, Juan Carlos Fernández-Cadena, Mohamed Hijri, Gary A Strobel
pmc-12654167.description: Plants inhabiting arid regions often harbor microbial communities that contribute to their resilience under extreme conditions. Yet, the genomic diversity and functional potential of bacterial endophytes associated with desert-adapted plants, particularly in Africa, remain largely unexplored. In this study, we investigated Microbacterium endophytes from the xerophytic cucurbit Citrullus colocynthis L. (Cucurbitaceae), collected in a semi-arid environment in central Morocco.

pmc-12708961.title: Strategic communication for NCD prevention: Enhancing visibility, engagement and policy action in Europe
pmc-12708961.creator: Sólveig Karlsdóttir, Anita T Munch, Hugrún Snorradóttir
pmc-12708961.description: Background:JA PreventNCD represents a collaborative European Union initiative aimed at reducing the burden of non-communicable diseases (NCDs) across Europe by targeting common risk factors and addressing health inequalities.Aims:This article outlines the comprehensive communication and dissemination work developed to enhance the Joint Action on Cancer and other NCDs prevention: Action on Health Determinants (JA PreventNCD) project’s visibility, impact and stakeholder engagement.

pmc-12788598.title: Clinical and Radiographic Assessment of Injectable Platelet-Rich Fibrin in the Treatment of Intrabony Defects
pmc-12788598.creator: E. Amuthavalli, Balamurugan Mani, Jareen Abdul Jafeer
pmc-12788598.description: Background:Injectable platelet-rich fibrin (i-PRF) has emerged as a bioactive material in periodontal regeneration due to its rich content of growth factors and ease of application. However, its clinical efficacy in managing intrabony defects remains underexplored.Objective:To evaluate the clinical and radiographic outcomes of intrabony defect treatment using i-PRF in comparison with open flap debridement (OFD) alone.

pmc-12882269.title: Insights into the dynamic cell associated and secreted proteome of Staphylococcus aureus cultured in TSB and milk media: a proteomic analysis
pmc-12882269.creator: Wanting Zhu, Yujing Wang, Yanxin Li, Changjiang Zang, Hongning Jiang, Qijing Du, Jun Wang, Rongbo Fan, Rongwei Han, Yongxin Yang
pmc-12882269.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). The availability of nutrients is closely linked to the protein expression profile of microorganisms. In this study, a comparative investigation has been performed to examine the expression patterns of cell associated proteins and secreted proteins in Staphylococcus aureus cultivated in TSB and milk media at three time points: 3 h, 9 h, and 18 h of the growth stage using proteomic techniques.

pmc-13091228.title: Neonatal amygdala microstructure and structural connectivity are associated with autistic traits at 2 years of age
pmc-13091228.creator: Kadi Vaher, Samuel R. Neal, Manuel Blesa Cábez, Lorena Jiménez-Sánchez, Amy Corrigan, David Q. Stoye, Helen L. Turner, Rebekah Smikle, Hilary Cruickshank, Magda Rudnicka, Mark E. Bastin, Michael J. Thrippleton, Rebecca M. Reynolds, James P. Boardman
pmc-13091228.description: Prenatal maternal stress is linked to neurodevelopmental outcomes. Maternal hair cortisol concentration in pregnancy is associated with neonatal amygdala microstructure and structural connectivity, suggesting that amygdala is sensitive to antenatal stress. We investigated whether amygdala microstructure and/or connectivity associate with neurodevelopmental outcomes.

pmc-13141983.title: CytoSorb haemoadsorption in critically ill children: a multicentre observational study on feasibility, safety, and outcomes, the CYTOPED study
pmc-13141983.creator: Gabriella Bottari, Stefania Bianzina, Anna Tessari, Monica Fae, Sara Giovannini, Stefano Scollo, Elena Caporossi, Fabio Paglialonga, Pietro Lonardi, Raffaella Sagredini, Alessandro Simonini, Fabio Caramelli, Germana Longo, Corrado Cecchetti, Andrea Moscatelli, Isabella Guzzo
pmc-13141983.description: Graphical abstract Introduction Adsorption is an extracorporeal blood purification technique that aims to remove mediators, solutes, cells, or pathogens through plasma or haemoadsorption (HA) [1]. HA presents several advantages making the diffusion of these techniques exponentially increasing in the last 10 year.

pmc-13419875.title: Atomic Accuracy: Unmasking a Colonic Dieulafoy Lesion With a Nuclear Medicine Scan
pmc-13419875.creator: Christine B Kwak, Charleston R Powell, Nicole M Harrison
pmc-13419875.description: Obscure gastrointestinal bleeding (OGIB) poses a unique diagnostic challenge as diagnosis may require repeat endoscopy, enteroscopy, video capsule endoscopy, contrasted imaging, or nuclear medicine (NM) scans. Dieulafoy lesions are enlarged submucosal vessels in a background of normal mucosa, typically found in the stomach, occasionally in the small bowel, and rarely in the colon.

pmc-13491101.title: Severe malaria-bacterial sepsis co-infection among critically ill children admitted to pediatric emergency departments in Kinshasa
pmc-13491101.creator: Mamy-Gloire Monkoti Manzi, Celestin Nsibu, Joseph Bodi, Philippe Jouvet
pmc-13491101.description: BACKGROUNDSevere malaria remains a major cause of pediatric critical illness and early mortality in sub-Saharan Africa. In pediatric emergency settings, concomitant bacterial sepsis is often under-recognized because of overlapping clinical manifestations, which may delay appropriate antimicrobial therapy and worsen outcomes. Data on severe malaria-bacterial sepsis co-infection among critically ill children in Kinshasa remain limited.
